areas.title: Calls of one subscriber
areas.exercises: How many voice calls, how long, when, to whom and on which day: counts of calls made and received, talk time, the longest and the average call, calls at night, calls over ten minutes, the first and last event, the number called most, the busiest day, how many different numbers were contacted.
areas.where: Ask this case: the sentence first, then the table and "Behind this answer".

areas.title: Text messages of one subscriber
areas.exercises: How many text messages were sent and received, to whom most, and when the first was sent.

areas.title: A subscriber and one other number
areas.exercises: How many calls and messages two numbers had, how many outgoing calls, the total duration, and when they last had contact.
areas.where: Ask this case; the lines of the answer open into the records.

areas.title: Internet sessions
areas.exercises: Sessions, bytes downloaded and uploaded, the number of different apps, the app and the host used most, and which number has the most sessions.

areas.title: App usage
areas.exercises: Records of app use per number, the number of different apps and the one used most.

areas.title: Bank and wallet accounts
areas.exercises: Transactions of an account, the totals credited and debited, the largest debit, the last balance, the first and last day, the account paid the most, how many different accounts were paid, who sent money, debits above an amount.
areas.where: Ask this case. Amounts are as the statement gives them.

areas.title: Vehicle plates and cameras
areas.exercises: How often a plate was seen, at which cameras, when first and last; how many sightings a camera recorded and how many different plates; the plate seen the most.
areas.where: Ask this case. A sighting says that a camera read a plate, not who was driving.

areas.title: Handsets
areas.exercises: Which handset (IMEI) a number was seen with and with how many.

areas.title: Cell sites
areas.exercises: The cell site a number used most and how many different cell sites it used. A cell site is a coverage area, not a position.

areas.title: Registrations
areas.exercises: Which SIM identity a number is registered with and the status of the registration. A registration is what a source file states, not who holds the number.

areas.title: The evidence files
areas.exercises: How many files the case holds, in total and by type.
